_schema.resourceProvenance: Policy-resolved verification.fonts/assets source file includes provenance {schemaVersion:1, policyHash, ruleId, origin, license?, version?}. Fonts require license and version. Consume resolver output, never invent it. With a policy all file sources require current provenance; without it legacy explicit registration remains valid. Offline gates check bytes/authorization, not authenticity or rendered fidelity.
_schema.behaviorMeasurementBaseline: Optional verification.cases[].measurementBaseline names another behavior case linked to the same fidelity baseline, with identical source/environment/states and no measurementBaseline of its own. Use a separately measured visible reference for initially hidden optional text. Both behavior cases remain mandatory; vary content against the selected reference, not hidden fidelity bounds.
_schema.externalFloatSerialization: externalVariables retains resolved sourced snapshots. FLOAT serialization decisions belong to figma-state.json.externalSerialization[variableId] as { css, source }; never infer px or declare the decision as a property of the library.
_schema.computedColorAudit: Existing binding/literal observation + variant + part + cssProperty mappings enable single-solid sRGB computed-color checks. Raw snapshot aliases resolve in each case mode; computed PASS does not prove visible paint, a loaded mask or internal delegated consumption. No declared PASS or extra verification field belongs here.
_schema.nativeStateVerification: Optional per verification.cases[].states[]: verification { kind: native, selector: scoped CSS selector, property: checked or disabled, value: boolean }; kind pseudo supports hover/focus/focus-visible, with focus optionally asserting focus-visible. Preserve activation instructions and observe nativeStates in the original measurement, never infer PASS from props/actions.
_schema.browserActions: Optional per verification.cases[]: actions is an ordered array (maximum 32) of { kind: hover or click, selector } or { kind: press, key }. Supported keys: Tab, Shift+Tab, ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right, Space, Enter, Escape. Pointer targets must belong uniquely to the outer component root. Actions execute real input, not DOM mutation or synthetic state props, and do not prove the expected state. Interactive previews wait for activation before collection; environment browsers can activate then call collect/F8.
